content.user_title: Optimize React Native Apps with AI Rules
content.value_statement: React Native agents often miss mobile performance details that affect scrolling, animations, and native behavior. This skill gives Codex, Claude, and Claude Code concrete rules for safer React Native work.
actual_capabilities: Guides React Native rendering safety, including Text wrapping and safer conditional output.
Reviews list implementations for virtualization, stable references, memoization, and lightweight rows.
Recommends Reanimated patterns for transform, opacity, shared values, and gesture-based press states.
Covers native navigation, native modals, menus, safe areas, and optimized image handling.
Provides state, React Compiler, monorepo, dependency, font, and import organization guidance.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not runtime profiling or automated benchmark results.
It does not inspect native build output unless the host agent reads those files.
Some recommendations depend on React Compiler, Expo version, or project dependencies.
It cannot guarantee performance improvements without device testing.

use_cases.title: Review Mobile Screens
use_cases.description: Audit React Native screens for rendering crashes, expensive list items, and unsafe scroll patterns before release.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Guidance
use_cases.description: Give reviewers a shared checklist for performance, native navigation, images, modals, menus, and state architecture.

use_cases.title: Improve AI Refactors
use_cases.description: Help AI agents generate changes that match modern React Native, Expo, Reanimated, and virtualized list practices.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native component for rendering safety and basic performance. Focus on Text wrapping, conditional rendering, and Pressable usage.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a List
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this feed or search list for re-render risks. Recommend virtualized list, memoization, callback, and image changes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Animations
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Reanimated interaction for smooth UI thread behavior. Prefer transform, opacity, shared values, and GestureDetector patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Screen Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this React Native screen across list, state, navigation, safe area, and image rules. Propose a staged refactor with testable steps.

output_examples.input: Review a product grid screen with images and infinite scroll.
output: Use a virtualized list instead of mapping children inside ScrollView.
Request thumbnail images at the rendered size plus retina scale.
Move expensive data work to the parent screen.

output_examples.input: Check an animated card press state.
output: Drive press feedback with GestureDetector callbacks on the UI thread.
Animate scale and opacity rather than layout properties.
Keep the shared value as press state and derive visual values from it.

output_examples.input: Review navigation and modal choices for a settings flow.
output: Prefer native stack and native tabs for platform behavior.
Use native modal presentation where it fits the interaction.
Keep safe area and content inset behavior aligned with platform defaults.

best_practices: Use the skill before generating React Native components, then align changes with the cited rule files.
Ask for focused review by area, such as lists, animations, navigation, or state.
Validate recommendations with profiling, device testing, and the app design system.
anti_patterns: Do not treat examples as app-specific requirements without checking the target project.
Do not apply list optimizations that conflict with React Compiler or existing virtualizer choices.
Do not replace native dependencies without checking Expo, platform, and monorepo constraints.

faq.question: Does this skill modify code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides the host AI agent. The agent still needs project files and user approval for edits.

faq.question: Which projects does it support?
faq.answer: It supports React Native and Expo apps, including projects that use Reanimated, React Navigation, and virtualized lists.

faq.question: Does it require Vercel services?
faq.answer: No. The skill is published by Vercel Labs, but the guidance is general React Native and Expo guidance.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. It should guide the agent to follow local components, imports, and platform UI patterns.

faq.question: Is it only about performance?
faq.answer: No. It also covers rendering safety, navigation, UI patterns, monorepos, dependencies, fonts, and React Compiler compatibility.

faq.question: How should I prompt it?
faq.answer: Ask for a focused audit or refactor area and include the relevant screen, component, or navigation files.
